facts.business: Fynx Capital Limited (formerly Rajath Finance Limited) is a non-banking financial company engaged in lending operations with a focus on loan portfolio growth and credit quality.

auditor.name: N. C. Vaishnav & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company has accumulated losses resulting in negative reserves of Rs 412.36 Lakhs as at 31 March 2026. The Company's ability to continue as a going concern is dependent on continued growth and maintenance of credit quality of the loan portfolio and timely servicing of its borrowings.

key_risks: Accumulated losses and negative reserves of Rs 412.36 Lakhs as at 31 March 2026
Going concern dependency on continued growth and maintenance of credit quality of loan portfolio
Completeness and accuracy of interest income recognition
Appropriateness of ECL provisioning on newly originated portfolio
Accuracy of Direct Selling Agent (DSA) commission accruals
